name: Idol
overview: The Scriptures clearly prohibit the making and worshipping of idols, emphasizing that no other gods should be placed before the one true God (Exodus 20:3-4). The account of the golden calf demonstrates the danger of turning to crafted images as gods, which leads to spiritual corruption and judgment (Exodus 32:3-4, 20). Furthermore, God's people are warned against participating in idolatrous practices, including eating sacrifices offered to idols, underscoring the call to remain separate and devoted solely to Him (Exodus 34:15). These passages reveal that idols, whether made of gold, silver, wood, or stone, are powerless and their worship is forbidden.
